description:
Declarative specification of an invariant or temporal property over trajectories.

Every PropertySpec has a deterministic cryptographic SHA-256 hash computed
over its canonical representation.

definition.description: Structured specification payload (e.g. oracle graph nodes/edges or STL formula).
definition.title: Definition

description.description: Formal or narrative explanation of the requirement.
description.title: Description

metadata.description: Author, domain tags, or reference documentation.
metadata.title: Metadata

parameters.description: Thresholds, timing tolerance windows, or evaluation hyperparameters.
parameters.title: Parameters

property_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this verification property.
property_id.title: Property Id

title: PropertySpec
